# Apropos Business Opportunity Agency

> Creating Business Success Through Procurement Intelligence.

Apropos Business Opportunity Agency is a nonprofit opportunity development organization focused on helping businesses discover, pursue, and participate in opportunities that can contribute to business growth, economic participation, and stronger communities.

## Primary Focus

- Procurement intelligence
- Government contracting opportunities
- Business opportunity development
- Supplier and subcontracting opportunities
- Business growth and economic participation
- Partnerships with cities, counties, public agencies, economic-development organizations, chambers, colleges, universities, financial institutions, foundations, and institutional buyers

## Core Positioning

Opportunity Builds Business. Business Builds Community.

The Agency works to improve the connection between businesses and the opportunities, buyers, markets, resources, capital, and partnerships that can help them grow.

## Government Marketplace

The Agency helps make relevant federal, state, county, municipal, educational, and other public-sector contracting opportunities easier for businesses to discover and pursue.

## Business Opportunity Development

The Agency supports pathways that include government contracting, private-sector opportunities, supplier and subcontracting opportunities, business-development resources, capital and funding resources, technical assistance, strategic partnerships, market expansion, entrepreneurship resources, and local or regional economic-development initiatives.
